name: execution (bare tools): a run approved with /approve is actually executed
description: The Galaxy tools are galaxy-ops operations registered in-process under bare names. Slash-command twin of execution-after-approval-tools, which approves in plain language. The proposal id is seeded (ORBIT_EVAL_PROPOSAL_IDS), so the second turn can type /approve with the id loom_propose will mint; every seeded mint logs proposal.id_seeded, so a seeded run is always identifiable. --yes is needed because json mode has no dialog, and a slash command starts no agent turn, hence the third turn that tells the agent to run it. Asserts that the proposal was created by loom_propose, approved by the user's /approve, and that the agent then actually called the tool. activity.ordered fails the run if the tool was called before the approval landed, since approval does not yet block submission.
inputs: Run the Add column tool (tool id `addValue`) on the first dataset in history hist1, adding the value 7 as a new column. Write the plan to the notebook, propose the run with loom_propose, and wait for my approval.
Approved. Go ahead and run it.
